name: PDF.co
tagline: PDF generation, editing, OCR, barcode, and document conversion REST API suite.
description: PDF.co is a cloud REST API platform for generating, editing, converting, and processing PDF and other documents. Developers use it for PDF creation from HTML/templates, merge/split, OCR text extraction, barcode reading/generation, and format conversion via authenticated HTTPS endpoints.

auth.details: API key via x-api-key header (or query string); self-serve signup at app.pdf.co.
